steps.note: Open the eRFX creation flow for the RFQ event.
Enable lot creation for the test company as required.
Configure the event with an RFQ stage, which is required for lot creation.
Apply the first available RFQ template before adding line items.
Create multiple line items so the lot validation can require assignment across at least two lots.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet for the line items.
Commit a valid event schedule before publishing.
Add the required QA test vendor participant.
Publish the RFQ so its buyer-side lot controls are available.
Confirm the event reached its published project page.

args.goal: On the buyer's published RFQ page, open the lot creation drawer, put every line item into lot 1, save the lot plan, and leave the refusal visible.

steps.note: Perform the lot assignment and save action that has no dedicated catalog step.

args.text: Please assign line item to at least two lots

steps.note: Verify the required refusal when all line items are in only one lot.
